# REQ-nnn — <short title>

> 🇻🇳 Mẫu yêu cầu. Copy vào `docs/requirements/REQ-nnn-<slug>.md` và link với issue `type:req`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Status | Draft / Clarifying / Ready / In progress / Done / Rejected |
| Requested by | <role> on YYYY-MM-DD |
| Priority | prio:p1–p4 · MoSCoW |
| Size | small / normal / large (large → RFC) |
| Issue | #… |

## 1. Problem and goal

What problem, for whom, and how we will know it is solved (metric or observable outcome).
> 🇻🇳 Vấn đề gì, cho ai, đo thế nào là đã giải quyết.

## 2. Scope

**In scope:** …
**Out of scope:** …

## 3. Clarification log

| # | Question | Answer | By / date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | | | |

## 4. User stories and acceptance criteria

```text
As a <role>, I want <capability>, so that <benefit>.

Scenario: <name>
  Given …
  When  …
  Then  …
```

## 5. Non-functional requirements

Performance, security, availability, data retention, accessibility — only what applies.
> 🇻🇳 Yêu cầu phi chức năng — chỉ ghi những gì áp dụng.

## 6. Definition of Ready

- [ ] Goal and out-of-scope stated
- [ ] Acceptance criteria testable (QA agreed)
- [ ] Open questions answered or parked
- [ ] Dependencies available
- [ ] Estimate ≤ 6 sessions (or split)
- [ ] RFC planned (large only)

## 7. Estimate and plan

Tasks with estimates in sessions; link to backlog IDs.
